_comment: The DEPLOYED NN stack: exactly the two neural networks that execute every flight in the reliable demo (record_sensor_demo.py, default --controller classical): fused_full = the all-sensor CNN+LSTM nav net (runs every 50Hz step), and yolov8_nano_64x96 = the FPV gate/person detector (runs ~4Hz, routed through the safety layer with --safety). The flight CONTROLLER is the analytic Lee velocity law (not a neural net, so it has no dispatch graph to schedule) -- the RL/MLP controller (mlp_control) exists but flies worse (analytic-beats-RL) and is not deployed, so it is NOT in this schedule. YOLO is the dominating network, split (sharded) across harts to hold its detection deadline. Periods = real firing rates; num_instances RT-driven. The MLP controller + transformer vision-head (IME) are co-design TARGETS shown separately, not padding here.
